title: On Request: A2A extension https://agent-capability.org/ext/on-request/v1
description: Draft 0.1, 1 Nov 2026, not published. Defines the params of the AgentExtension declared in AgentCard.capabilities.extensions (params) and the object placed in Message.metadata or Artifact.metadata under the extension URI (reply). Checks a schema cannot make (each id names a skill in the same card; no listed skill carries securityRequirements; no on-request value in skill text) are left to validators.

personEntry.description: Where a person asks: an https address on an origin the operator controls, or a tel: number answered by or for the operator. The same for every caller; carries nothing about the person (OR-3.4, OR-3.8).

id.description: The id of an AgentSkill in the same card (OR-3.3).

assistantAccess.description: The operator's opt-in (OR-3.5). Absent means false.

completion.description: For a skill that changes something in the operator's systems (OR-3.6).

then.description: An action needs an https address (OR-3.4).

agentExtension.description: The whole AgentExtension entry as it appears in the Agent Card (OR-3.1).

reply.description: The object in Message.metadata or Artifact.metadata under the key https://agent-capability.org/ext/on-request/v1 (§6).
